en.title: Try the new HikariSub 0.1 beta
highlights: Projects: open a show's folder and its fonts, catalogues, presets and scripts are shared, with several windows and dockable layouts.
Hikari AI times karaoke, typesets signs and translates, and every edit waits for you to keep or undo it. You can turn it all off.
Plugins from a marketplace, including Macro chains, Keyframe generator and Git line marks, each in a sandbox.
Visual typesetting with perspective, gradients, text on a path and motion tracking, and karaoke effects built as node graphs.
Spelling and grammar checks, QC notes, export to SRT, WebVTT, TTML and more, and signed updates.
en.note: This is a beta. It installs over 0.0.x and only reads its settings, so you can go back by reinstalling 0.0.x at any time.
